invariants.rationale: Method operates on the data list; null data would likely result in a NullPointerException.
reduceFunc is called within a reduce operation, so it must be non-null for correct execution.
Parallelism parameter is typically expected to be a positive integer controlling parallel execution.
Parallelism should not exceed the size of the input list to avoid excessive splitting; input constraints may expect parallelism <= data.size().
The stream operations expect non-null elements in data; this prevents possible NullPointerExceptions.
